title: Prediction Is Not Calibration: Item Parameter Recovery and Representation Coupling in Knowledge Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2610.30211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge tracing (KT) models can estimate item parameters through an item response decoder trained solely for next-response prediction, yet predictive accuracy does not guarantee parameter recovery. We study 2PL, GPCM, and NRM decoders paired with LSTM, Transformer, and DKVMN encoders. Response-model derivatives show why discrimination and option slope updates depend directly on the scale and spread of estimated ability. Affine logit identities show how item-dependent shifts and rescaling in estimated ability are absorbed into item parameters without changing response probabilities. In simulations, difficulty, mean threshold, and correct-option intercept recovery remain high under shuffled order across representation widths, whereas discrimination and keyed option slope contrast recovery require wider item representations and degrade further under fixed item order. translated_title: 预测不等于校准：知识追踪中的项目参数恢复与表示耦合
translated_abstract: 知识追踪（KT）模型可以通过仅针对下一次作答预测而训练的作答响应解码器来估计项目参数，但预测准确性并不能保证参数的恢复。我们研究了2PL、GPCM和NRM三种解码器分别与LSTM、Transformer和DKVMN三种编码器配对的组合。响应模型的导数分析揭示了为什么区分度和选项斜率的更新直接依赖于估计能力的量级与离散程度。仿射logit恒等式表明，估计能力中与项目相关的平移和缩放可以在不改变作答概率的情况下被吸收进项目参数中。在模拟实验中，在项目顺序被打乱的条件下，难度、平均阈值和正确选项截距的恢复在不同表示宽度下均保持较高水平，而区分度和正确选项斜率对比度的恢复则需要更宽的项目表示，并且在固定项目顺序下会进一步退化。将序列项目表示（宽度 $d_S$）与项目（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文揭示知识追踪模型中预测准确并不等于项目参数可被正确恢复——难度类参数恢复稳健，而区分度和选项斜率的恢复依赖更宽的项目表示并与项目顺序存在耦合。
en_tdlr: Predictive accuracy in knowledge tracing does not guarantee item parameter recovery: difficulty-type parameters are recovered robustly, while discrimination and option slope recovery requires wider item representations and is coupled to item order.
